inspection_method: Each final PNG opened using view_image and visually inspected by this release context after the last rebuild.

rendered_pages.observation: Title, abstract, model, piecewise definition, coefficients and full theorem all legible; equation labels 1-4 and metadata footnotes clear.
Related literature, symmetry, exact branches, constants, local lemma and Wallis normalization fit; all fraction and floor/symmetry indices legible.
Finite product, CDF constant, local sum orientations and quadrature proof checked; wide displays and the corrected paragraph have no overflow.
Ratio bounds, rational expansion, grid estimate, zero smoothness and constants checked; endpoint signs and stacked fractions clear.
Uniform Taylor conclusion, central identities, all finite count/range assertions, direct library citation and assistance disclosure checked; nothing clipped.
All six references, complete authors, version/status, URLs, affiliation and email are readable; intentional remaining white space is not missing content.
